modules.module_title: Assembly Techniques for CRT & Plasma TVs

pcs.pc_description: Secure and mount the CRT tube onto the assembly frame with proper brackets and degaussing coil wiring.
Align and install the plasma screen onto the designated mounting frame and secure it with necessary screws.
Attach the speaker to the front cabinet of the television.
Connect the auxiliary/speaker PCB to the system.
Connect the main PCB, power supply board, and display driver board to the assembly
Wire necessary grounding connections and safety circuits
Perform voltage checks and necessary adjustments to avoid display distortions in CRT and plasma screens.
Make adjustments such as white balance calibration, color accuracy tuning, and audio-video synchronization tests.
Attach the back cover and prepare the unit for final testing and packaging.
Verify that the finished assembly meets the required specifications and quality standards.
Inspect the aesthetics of the front and back panels for defects.

modules.module_title: Assembly Techniques for LCD, LED, OLED, QLED, Mini-LED, Micro-LED TVs

modules.module_title: Achieving Productivity, Quality, and Safety Standards

pcs.pc_description: Meet 100% of the target number of products to be manufactured per day
Achieve 100% completion of planned work as per schedule.
Maintain a zero-error assembly process as per company standards.
Use grounded wrist straps and other electrostatic precautions as applicable.
Keep the work area clean and organized, and report any issues in the assembly line promptly
Complete work without hazards and follow clean work protocols.
Ensure proper labeling of products as per guidelines.
Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
Identify risks like sharp tools, glass panels, static electricity; follow all safety signs and instructions.
